desc: After years of development and time spent in the field, Burris introduces the BTS35 Version 3 – a revolutionary leap forward in night hunting technology. Expertly engineered to push the boundaries of performance, the BTS35 v3 brings together a seamless blend of top-tier components and design to deliver a simple, fast, and powerful experience, empowering you to seize the night. With Burris Cybercore technology, a 400x300 resolution thermal riflescope, and features like picture-in-picture, hot spot tracking, and 10 customizable reticles, the BTS35 v3 delivers unprecedented detail and redefines the night hunting experience. The BTS35 v3 not only introduces video recording capabilities and remote device control through the BurrisConnect app but also addresses power concerns with unparalleled runtimes, battery hot swapping, and convenient USB-C charging. Additionally, the advanced rotary dial control system, inspired by popular video game menus, ensures virtually effortless navigation even in total darkness. Say farewell to limitations and embrace the future of night hunting with the Burris BTS35 v3.
